verdict.rationale: Meltano documents a supported SDK for building custom Singer connectors ('Build your own Meltano connector to move data from any source to any destination', 'The SDK for Singer Connectors & EDK for Meltano Components are easy to use'), and community evidence corroborates real-world use ('When I had to develop a custom tap for a client, the support I received from the team, the SDK and the general experience was absolutely top class'). This is a first-party framework, not a fork. Missing for 10: deeper first-party SDK tutorial/reference excerpts and more independent hands-on reports beyond a single HN comment.
